title: The Cutting Edge: Week of September 13th
body:
**Highlights**
- Edgeware ecosystem contributor and Agency CEO, Thom Ivy talked about [the Substrate ecosystem, the EDG direction and the possibilities Edgeware brings to Polkadot & Kusama ecosystem](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1437816680135241735?s=20) on the ‘ChainTrends Crypto’ YT channel.
- Edgeware’s governance and discussion forum powered by Commonwealth got [a new Beta feature](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1439979675485417481?s=20) that allows users to launch and view Tips from the Treasury.
- All validators are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [latest release v3.3.3](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases/tag/v3.3.3) to proceed further with the ERUP4/Wako upgrade through the on-chain governance. The core community dev Ramsey recently shared [the docker image for v3.3.3 aka ERUP4/Wako upgrade](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1438226365833175048?s=20) to save the compiling hustle for node/validator owners.
- Get to know more technical oriented updates on the ‘[EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-dev-digest-sep-12/)’.


**Ecosystem Updates**
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on Edgeware, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.
- Webb Protocol released their [Technical Roadmap](https://twitter.com/webbprotocol/status/1426959047337693195?s=20).


**Governance**
- No active referendum. Upcoming: [ERUP4/Wako upgrade](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/1100-erup-4-substrate-30-evm-updates-runtime-modules)


**Community**
- The Calendar of events has many items each week, meetings on NFTs, DAOs, chain strategy and governance- whatever you're interested in, [take a look](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/1059-edgeware-community-calendar-add-to-your-gcal).
